body:
Native GUI now has full Friends & Duels social UI (3 tabs: FRIENDS/REQUESTS/DUELS) reachable from the Main Menu, matching the web client and WOTAN pages. New core/iduna.c dwi_* functions (profile/friend-requests/friends/duels) and a new dw_json_array_at() JSON multi-item parsing primitive in core/http.c. Verified via a 10/10-assertion unit test against a fake IDUNA (ASan/UBSan clean) and live Xvfb+xdotool screenshots of the real compiled dw_gui binary. Full build.sh --gui suite green, no regressions. Commit 3902cab. Closes the native-client half of SECTION 537; Duel Phase 2 (accepted duel -> live match) remains open.

⚓ ☃
title: Friends & Duels screen in the native SDL2 client (S537)
